correctness.rationale: The frozen ten-vertex graph is KG(5,2), with K_r all subsets whose largest connected component has ≤r vertices, and all 1≤r≤10 plus r≥10 contractibility. Independently generated all 1023 nonempty subsets and their exact component-size levels, then fetched and exhaustively checked the 47,656-byte certificate.json (Git blob 6f51d9bb81d3d14d5d981f59f37759cafd26037e). For each r=1..10, every P removal was verified as a unique surviving codimension-one coface, every C removal as a maximal surviving face, and complete exhaustion with face counts 75,260,380,510,702,857,967,1012,1022,1023 and critical cells (one vertex plus 4 S²; 1 S³;1 S³;11 S³;61 S⁴;74 S⁵;36 S⁶;9 S⁷;1 S⁸;only vertex). This complete finite elementary-collapse certificate gives integral sphere-wedge homotopy at each stage; not just F2 ranks. Independently reconstructed simplicial boundary matrices over F2 and the 1023-face filtration; persistence reduction produced exactly (dimension,birth,death,multiplicity) (2,1,2,4),(3,2,5,1),(3,4,5,10),(4,5,6,61),(5,6,7,74),(6,7,8,36),(7,8,9,9),(8,9,10,1), plus one essential H0. No integral persistence module structure or equivariance is claimed.

value.rationale: The Petersen graph is the natural canonical small nonchordal cubic graph, and higher-independence complexes form a recent structural topological invariant. A complete finite r=1..10 integral homotopy classification and full finite F2 barcode reveal genuine class births, survivals and deaths not implied by the known r2 sphere or routine homology tables. Exact all-parameter results are useful benchmark facts for discrete Morse and persistence studies even without a wider graph-family theorem.

limitations: Integral wedge homotopy at each stage and F2 persistence only; no integral persistence module or group action is asserted.
